Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANIT Bhopal Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The application is through a Walk-in interview, and the date for the interview is 27-10-2026. There is no separate last date for online application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc in relevant fields or a B.Tech/B.E. with a minimum CGPA of 7.5 and GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 33 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- Per Month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for MANIT Bhopal JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
